· SMA100/200 ($438.15/$430.61) relative position: mid/long-term trend strength maintained

[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (54.5 → 63.3) + entering overbought + sustained upward momentum
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.7997 → -0.7997) + holding steady + no trend reversal signal
· Bollinger Band current price position (upper band $514.04) + band width at 5.60% level
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($506.00) + based on SMA20
· Swing resistance ($517.78) + potential for further upside on breakout

[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis (uptrend) + short-term wait-and-see condition due to overbought entry
